name_note: The _A suffix marks a GTDB split, so s__Ruminococcoides intestinale_A is narrower than the published species Ruminococcoides intestinale; its genomes are deposited in NCBI under the name Ruminococcus intestinalis.

sentences.text: Ruminococcoides intestinale was named from a publicly available collection of bacterial strains cultured from the human gut microbiome.
That collection describes it as a new dominant species associated with health, alongside Blautia intestinihominis, which is associated with inflammatory bowel disease.
The genus Ruminococcoides was proposed for a bile-resistant strain isolated from human bile and placed in the family Ruminococcaceae.
The type species Ruminococcoides bili mainly metabolized resistant starches to form formate, lactate and acetate.
A review lists Ruminococcoides bili among recently reported degraders of resistant starch in the gut.
